statement.excerpt: A few days ago he triumphantly claimed (without evidence) that nearly all code would be written by AI within the next year:

our_interpretation: Assess whether Amodei supplied supporting evidence in the remarks, not whether his prediction eventually came true.
The referenced occasion is the March 10, 2025 Council on Foreign Relations discussion.
Evidence includes supporting data, research, or concrete observations. Evidence need not conclusively prove a forecast.
General observations about improving AI capabilities may support the direction of a prediction without establishing its particular deadline.

criteria.contradiction_condition: The record shows that Amodei supplied empirical observations or research supporting the prediction, even if that support was weak.
